name: PIDNA — Pure Intelligence DNA research project
canonical_role: Study whether conjecture and independently grounded verification form an outcome-bound causal recurrence that produces durable changed HSWM behavior across scales.
conceptual_delta: Recasts the historical ascending double-helix metaphor as a typed n-ary temporal hypergraph recurrence and reopens functional scale self-similarity without restoring retired LakatoTree governance machinery.

research_object.blue_role: schema-admissible conjecture, prediction, proposal, and initiating trajectory
research_object.red_role: independently grounded observation, intervention, measurement, falsifier, and instrument uncertainty
research_object.rung: typed n-ary outcome-binding incidence connecting proposal, trajectory, outcome, causal credit, admitted canonical revision, and changed later behavior
research_object.ascent: a sequence of valid rungs that improves prospective performance under fresh, retention, safety, and remove/restore controls
research_object.fractal_question: whether the same causal recurrence closes at component and bounded composite scales while preserving member identity, credit, rights, and lineage

fcl_scope.boundary: Functional recurrence is a falsifiable bridge to the mapped laws, not evidence that PIDNA or an HSWM currently realizes them.

hypotheses.name: paired-cycle advantage
hypotheses.test: Equal-budget comparison of blue-only, red-only, unpaired-log, and paired PIDNA arms.
hypotheses.reject_when: No preregistered gain in fresh causally validated revisions or gain is explained by extra calls, compute, latency, or human work.

hypotheses.name: behavioral rung
hypotheses.test: Intervene on outcome, credit, and revision then remove and restore the revision under fixed context.
hypotheses.reject_when: Later behavior is invariant to the rung or removal preserves the claimed effect.

hypotheses.name: hypergraph credit
hypotheses.test: Compare typed n-ary incidence with forced 1:1 pairs and flat logs on shared and delayed outcomes.
hypotheses.reject_when: Calibration, counterfactual attribution, and replay are no better under matched information and compute.

hypotheses.name: functional scale recurrence
hypotheses.test: Run the same causal recurrence at component and bounded composite scales under regrouping and model swap.
hypotheses.reject_when: The higher scale is central aggregation, loses member lineage or credit, or fails bounded intervention.

hypotheses.name: anti-Ragnarok verification
hypotheses.test: Measure verification burden and invariant effectiveness per causally validated revision as rungs accumulate.
hypotheses.reject_when: Static gates, exceptions, or evidence latency grow faster than causal learning yield.

nonclaims: PIDNA is not established biology or a validated theory of intelligence.
The retired Lean model is not a verified HSWM implementation.
A deterministic judge cannot establish the truth of ungrounded inputs.
No authorization to restore retired governance machinery.
Repository or KG presence is not cognition, learning, ascent, or evidence.
